metadata.description: AI Based Chatbot: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Blob Storage, App Service, Key Vault and monitoring. All service-to-service access uses managed identities.
Short lowercase alphanumeric prefix for all resource names (3-8 chars).
Environment name, used in resource names and tags.
Region for all resources except Azure OpenAI (see openAiLocation).
Extra tags applied to every resource.
Short resource names (<prefix>-web-<suffix>, <prefix>-openai-<suffix>, <prefix>-logs, ...) instead of <prefix>-<environment>-<suffix>-<type>. The demo uses them with the prefix "chatbot".
Region for the Azure OpenAI account. Must offer both models with the chosen deployment types. East US 2 offers the default models with every deployment type.
Azure OpenAI account tier.
Chat model that writes the answers.
Chat model version.
Reasoning effort sent to reasoning models such as gpt-5-mini (lower is faster and cheaper). Use none for models that do not reason.
Chat deployment type. Standard keeps processing in openAiLocation; DataZoneStandard and GlobalStandard may process prompts in other regions.
Chat deployment capacity, in thousands of tokens per minute (TPM).
Region for the embedding model. Empty means the same Azure OpenAI account and region as the chat model; another region creates a second Azure OpenAI account there.
Embedding model used to vectorise document chunks and questions. The index vector size follows from it (3-small: 1536, 3-large: 3072).
Embedding model version.
Embedding deployment type.
Embedding deployment capacity, in thousands of tokens per minute (TPM). Limits how fast documents are indexed.
Azure AI Search tier. free: one per subscription, 50 MB, no semantic ranker, and no managed identity (keys in Key Vault are used instead).
Search replicas (query throughput and availability). basic: 1-3, standard tiers: 1-12. Two or more for the read SLA.
Search partitions (index size). basic: 1-3, standard tiers: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 12.
Semantic ranker plan. free: 1,000 semantic queries a month; standard: pay per 1,000 queries; disabled: hybrid search without reranking.
Storage redundancy for the source documents.
Key Vault tier.
Log Analytics retention in days.
Send diagnostic logs from App Service, AI Search and Azure OpenAI to Log Analytics. Application Insights is always on.
Allow shared-key (account key) access to the storage account. Needed when deploying code from Azure Cloud Shell (run-from-package upload). A Free-tier search service turns it on anyway.
Log Analytics daily ingestion cap in GB (-1 = no cap).
App Service plan size (Linux).
Number of web app instances.
Name of an existing Linux App Service plan in this resource group and region to put the web app on. Empty creates a new plan from appServicePlanSku. An existing plan is never changed.
Deploy the application code from a public Git repository during the deployment (used by the Deploy to Azure button). The deploy scripts upload the code themselves and leave this off.
Public Git repository that holds the application code (used when deployAppCode is true).
Branch to deploy from repositoryUrl.
Let users add documents from the chat page. Uploads always require the upload key stored in Key Vault.
Key that protects document upload, stored in Key Vault as upload-api-key. Leave empty on a redeploy to keep the stored key.
Who can open the chat page. none: anyone with the address. password: a shared demo password (no Microsoft Entra ID app registration needed).
Shared password for authMode password, stored in Key Vault as demo-password. Leave empty on a redeploy to keep the stored password.
URL (with SAS) of a run-from-package zip that includes the dependencies. Set by the Cloud Shell code deployment so that infrastructure redeploys keep the running code.
Object ID of the user or service principal running the deployment. Gets data access for document ingestion. Leave empty to skip.
Principal type of deployerPrincipalId.
